name: tools-xkas-plus
title: xkas-plus
description:
xkas-plus is an assembler. It is an extension of xkas v14. It can apply assembly patches directly onto modified roms.

Supported architectures:
GBA THUMB CPU (ARM7TDMI THUMB)
SNES CPU (WDC 65816)
SNES SMP (Sony SPC700)
NES CPU (MOS 6502)
TG-16 / PC Engine CPU (Hudson HuC6280)
WDC 65C02 / 65SC02
CSG 65CE02
